about.title: I’d rather own an outcome than tick a task.
paras: I run my work the way I run AGility: I decide, I own it, and I fix what breaks.
School gives me the fundamentals: Python, NumPy, Pandas, regression. AGility is where I prove them on real businesses.
I use AI tools like Claude Code and LLM APIs to ship fast, but I understand and own every system I build. When something breaks, I know where to look.
about.both: Most developers can build it. Most founders can sell it. I do both.
